about: In a famine Abraham takes Sarah down to Egypt and has her say she is his sister; Pharaoh takes her, an angel with a sword of fire drives him to restore her, and sends them off with gifts and the maid Hagar. Sarah, still childless, gives Hagar to Abraham and Ishmael is born; after Isaac’s birth she grows jealous, and God tells Abraham to send Hagar and Ishmael away, promising Ishmael a great people and fixing the covenant and the blessing of the nations in Isaac.

sentences.l: And-again we-shall-inform-you that when gave-him God to-Abraham glory and-wealth, lacked children.
sentences.i: We shall tell you further how, when God had given Abraham glory and wealth, he lacked children.
sentences.n: ወ- ‘and’ begins almost every unit; it is the ordinary narrative joiner, so I note it only where it does more. ወካዕበ ‘and again’; ናየድዐክሙ is a first-person plural imperfect of the causative አየድዐ ‘make known’ with -ክሙ ‘you (pl.)’, ‘we shall make you know’ (?). ወሀቦ ‘he gave him’ is the perfect with the object suffix -ኦ, and the ለ- phrase ለአብርሃም restates the receiver. ክብረ has the -ä ending (construct ‘glory of’ or accusative); nothing follows for it to govern, so it is the plain object ‘glory’, with ወብዕለ ‘and wealth’. ኀጥአ ‘he lacked’ takes ውሉደ ‘children’ as object; the root usually means ‘err, sin’, and ‘lack’ is read from the context (?).

sentences.l: In-within their-bed speak Sarah and-Abraham, and-he-said-to-her: have-become-you barren; and-she-also said-to-him: not I barren but you;
sentences.i: They were talking together in their bed, Sarah and Abraham, and he said to her, “You have become barren”; and she said to him, “I am not barren, but you are;”
sentences.n: ኮንኪ ‘you (fem.) have become’ (perfect 2fs of ኮነ) with መካነ as the predicate, ‘barren’ (accusative). ‘Barren’ is read from the context (?): መካን usually means ‘place’, and I have not been able to check ‘barren’ in Dillmann. ወይእቲኒ ‘and she also’; አኮ አነ መካን ‘I am not barren’, አላ አንተ ‘but you’. The couple blame each other for childlessness; this exchange is not in Genesis. በውስተ ‘in, within’; ምስካቢሆሙ is ምስካብ ‘bed, lying place’ + -ሆሙ ‘their’ (singular, with the linking vowel before the suffix; ?). ይትናገሩ is the tä-stem imperfect ‘they converse’ (reciprocal). The speech verb recurs: ይቤ ‘he said’ with a suffix, ወይቤላ ‘and he said to her’ (-ላ ‘to her’); ትቤ ‘she said’, ትቤሎ ‘she said to him’ (-ሎ ‘to him’). The ‘said’ verb takes ይ- / ት- prefixes even in the past, so ትቤ has the same shape as ‘you said’ (compare ዘትቤለኒ in unit 13).

sentences.l: And-entered famine into land-of Canaan, and-heard Abraham that there-is-to-him grain in-land-of Egypt, city-of Pharaoh;
sentences.i: A famine came into the land of Canaan, and Abraham heard that there was grain in the land of Egypt, the city of Pharaoh;
sentences.n: ወቦአ ‘and it entered, came’ (ቦአ, perfect 3ms); ረኃብ ‘famine’ is the subject. ምድረ ‘land of’ is the construct state (ምድር + -ä): a noun followed by another noun gives ‘X of Y’, and the book writes it with ‑ä, so ምድረ ከናኦን ‘land of Canaan’. ከመ ቦ እክል ‘that there is grain’: ቦ is ‘there is to him’, used as ‘there is’; እክል ‘grain’. ሀገረ ‘city of’ is again a construct, in apposition to ብሔረ ግብጽ, ‘land of Egypt, the city of Pharaoh’. Genesis 12:10 has the same famine and the going down to Egypt.

sentences.i: When he had spent all his goods in mercy to the poor in the days of famine, not putting it off till the morrow, and the famine grew severe on the land of Canaan and there was nothing to eat, he said, “I thank God who gave to me; they are finished (?), together with my servants;”
sentences.n: A long unit, with three clauses joined by ወ-. ወሶበ ‘and when’ + አኅለቀ ‘he finished, used up’. በምሒረ ነዳይ ‘in mercy to the poor’ takes ምሒረ as a construct of a verbal noun ‘mercy of’ (?), ነዳይ ‘poor man’. እንዘ ኢይናፍቅ ‘while he did not hesitate’ (እንዘ + imperfect gives a circumstantial clause; the verb ናፈቀ is read from context, ?) ለጌሠም ‘till tomorrow’ (ጌሠም ‘morrow’). This is the Kebra Nagast’s own addition (not in Genesis): Abraham gave his wealth to the poor, a pious motive for the descent. ወጸንዐ ‘and it grew strong’; ወኀጥአ ዘይሴሰይ ‘and what one eats failed’ (ዘይሴሰይ ‘that which one eats’, ዘ- relative + imperfect, taken as the subject of ኀጥአ; ‘he lacked food’ is the other possibility, ?). ኣአኵቶ is written with the ኣ and looks like ‘I give thanks to him’ (1cs of አኰተ + -ኦ), taken as ‘I thank (God)’ (?). ዘወሀበኒ ‘who gave me’ (ዘ- + perfect + -ኒ ‘me’). አኅለቁ is a 3mp perfect, ‘they are finished’; its subject is not stated, and I leave it as ‘they’ (?), the phrase ምስለ አግብርትየ ‘together with my servants’ perhaps including the servants in the ruin.

sentences.n: ወባሕቱ ‘but’; እኅትየ ‘my sister’: Abraham calls his wife ‘sister’ from the start, which quietly prepares the lie of units 9–19 (see Genesis 20:12, where she is also his half-sister). The name is spelled ሰራ here but ሳራ elsewhere; the same woman. ኒዒ is written for ንዒ ‘come!’ (imperative 2fs), ንሖር ‘let us go’ (1cp jussive of ሖረ). ከመ ናድኅን ‘that we may save’: ከመ + a 1cp subjunctive of the causative አድኀነ (‘save’), ርእስነ ‘ourselves’ (lit. ‘our head’). እሞተ ረኃብ ‘from the death of famine’: እም- ‘from’ + construct ሞተ ‘death of’.

sentences.i: She said to him, “May it be as you please, my lord. If you die, I will die with you, and if you live, I will live with you, and I will not go beyond your word, for ever.”
sentences.n: ይኩን ‘let it be’ (jussive of ኮነ); ሥምረትከ ‘your pleasure’ (ሥምረት + -ከ ‘your’); እግዚእየ ‘my lord’ (-የ ‘my’), the usual address of a wife to her husband in this chapter. ወእመኒ ‘and if indeed’ (እመ + -ኒ). ሞትከ is the perfect ‘you die’ after ‘if’, and እመውት ‘I die’ the imperfect; so too ሐየውከ ‘you live’ and አሐዩ ‘I live’ (an irregular spelling of the 1cs, ?). ወአልብየ ‘and I have not’ (አልቦ + -የ ‘to me’); ዘእትዐደው ‘that I should go beyond, transgress’ (a relative with the imperfect). እምቃልከ ‘from your word’, እስከ ለዓለም ‘until for ever’. This is Sarah’s vow of obedience, the ground of her later consent; it has no parallel in Genesis 12. The ፨ here, rather than ።, ends a section.

sentences.n: በል ‘say!’ (2ms imperative of the irregular ‘say’ verb); ሰማዕኩ ‘I heard’. ዘእንበለ ሕግ ‘without law’ (ዘእንበለ ‘without’); ንብረቶሙ ‘their way of life’ (ንብረት ‘dwelling, manner of living’ + -ሙ ‘their’); በጣዖት ‘in idol-worship’ (ጣዖት is ‘idol’; the worship is implied by the phrase, ?); ወበዝሙት ‘and in fornication’. Genesis 12:12 gives only the fear of being killed for his wife’s beauty; this idolatry and licence is the Kebra Nagast’s own colouring of Egypt.

sentences.i: “So now, to keep me alive, if they ask you about me, say, ‘I am his sister,’ so that you save my life; otherwise (?) I shall die at the hands of foreigners.”
sentences.n: ወይእዜኒ ‘and now’. ከመ ታሕይዊ ‘that you (fem.) make live’: ከመ + a 2fs subjunctive of the causative አሕየወ, with ነፍስየ ‘my soul, my life’. በሊ ‘say!’ (2fs imperative); ለእመ ‘if’; ተስእሉኪ ‘they ask you’; በእንቲአየ ‘about me’. ታድኅንያ ‘that you save her’: the -ያ ‘her’ anticipates ለነፍስየ ‘my soul’ (the soul is feminine), the repeated-object pattern with ለ-. እሞት ‘I will die’; በእደ ‘by the hand of’ (construct); ነኪራን ‘foreigners’ (plural of ነኪር). The last clause, እሞት በእደ ነኪራን ‘I die at the hands of foreigners’, has no connective; I read it as the alternative, ‘otherwise I shall die’ (?). This is the request of Genesis 12:13: say she is his sister, that his life may be spared.

sentences.i: He said to him, “Do it, if you will please me”; and he gave him ጠፋልሐ (?) of silver, ten thousand, and took Sarah to make her his wife, and brought her into his house and laid her on his bed, and Pharaoh, king of Egypt, went in to her.
sentences.n: Who speaks in ወይቤሎ ግበርአ is not marked; I read Abraham, who consents on condition of payment, with Pharaoh paying (?). ግበርአ ‘do it!’ (imperative of ገብረ with a stray -አ, ?); ለእመ አሥመርከኒ ‘if you please me’ (causative of ሠመረ ‘be pleased’ + -ኒ ‘me’). ወወሀቦ ‘and he gave him’ (Pharaoh gave). ጠፋልሐ is a word I cannot identify, perhaps a measure or weight of silver (?); ፼ is the Ethiopic sign for 10,000, spoken ዐሠርቱ አእላፍ (?). ወነሥኣ ‘and he took her’; ከመ ይረስያ ብእሲቶ ‘that he make her his wife’: ረሰየ ‘make, appoint’ with -ያ ‘her’ and ብእሲቶ ‘his wife’ in the accusative. ወአእተዋ ‘and he brought her in’ (causative of ወተወ; ?); ዐራቱ ‘his bed’; ወቦአ ኀቤሃ ‘and he went in to her’, a delicate phrase, which the next unit shows did not end in intercourse. Compare Genesis 12:16 (gifts to Abram) and 12:15.

sentences.l: And-appeared-to-him angel-of God by-night while he-carries sword-of fire, and-drew-near to-him and-lit house from-his-flame and-wished he-kill-him;
sentences.i: An angel of God appeared to him in the night, carrying a sword of fire, and came close to him and lit the house with its flame, and wished to kill him;
sentences.n: አስተርአዮ ‘he appeared to him’ (the causative-reflexive አስተርአየ ‘be seen’ + -ኦ ‘to him’); መልአከ እግዚኣብሔር ‘angel of God’, a construct chain; ሰይፈ እሳት ‘sword of fire’, another. The image of a flaming sword recalls the cherubim’s sword at the gate of Eden (Genesis 3:24). ወአብርሀ ‘he lit up’ (causative of በርሀ); እምነበልባሉ ‘from his flame’ (እም- ‘from’, here the source of the light; ነበልባሉ ‘his flame’); ወፈቀደ ይቅትሎ ‘and he wished to kill him’. In Genesis 12:17 the LORD afflicts Pharaoh with plagues; here it is an angel.

sentences.n: ወወሀበቶ አጋር ‘and she gave him Hagar’: ወሀበቶ is the 3fs perfect + -ቶ ‘him’ (the book’s spelling of -ኦ after a fem. verb), with አጋር the object. ወቦአ ኀቤሃ ‘and he went in to her’. ወፀንሰት ሎቱ ‘and she conceived for him’; ወወለደት ‘and she bore’; ወሰመየቶ ስሞ እስማዔል ‘and she named him his name Ishmael’ (ሰመየ ‘name’; ስሞ ‘his name’ doubles the object). This chapter spells the name እስማዔል here and ይስማዔል later (unit 36, etc.); one name. In Genesis 16:11 the angel tells Hagar to name the child Ishmael, and 16:15 has Abram name him; here Sarah names him.

sentences.i: “I want him to live for me before you, while Sarah my sister is jealous because of the offspring you gave me in my old age (?), for Ishmael was fourteen years old before Isaac was born.”
sentences.n: እፈቅድ ‘I wish’ (imperfect) + a following subjunctive ይሕየወኒ ‘that he live for me’ (-ኒ as a dative ‘for me’); ቅድ ሜከ is for ቅድሜከ ‘before you’, split by a space (?). ወሳራ እኅትየ ‘and Sarah my sister’: Abraham calls his wife ‘sister’ also here (see unit 6). ትቀንእ ‘she is jealous’; ዘወሀብከኒ ዘርአ ‘the seed which you gave me’; በርሥኣኒ I take as ‘in my old age’ (?), a noun (the word is uncertain, and -ኒ is ‘me’ on a verb, not a usual ‘my’ on a noun, so the parse is doubtful, ?). እስመ ኮኖ ለይስማዔል ፲ወ፬ ዓመት ‘for it was to Ishmael fourteen years’: ኮኖ is ኮነ ‘it was’ with -ኦ ‘to him’; ፲ወ፬ is 14, spoken ዐሠርቱ ወአርባዕቱ. ዘእንበለ ይትወለድ ይስሓቅ ‘before Isaac was born’ (ዘእንበለ + a tä-stem subjunctive). Abraham was 86 at Ishmael’s birth (Genesis 16:16) and 100 at Isaac’s (21:5), so the figure fourteen is right.

sentences.i: but as for Ishmael, leave him to live before me, and I will make of him a great people; he will beget twelve peoples and reign over them;
sentences.n: ወለይስማዔልሰ ‘and as for Ishmael’ (ለ- fronting the topic, + emphatic -ሰ). ኅድጎ ‘leave him!’ (imperative + -ኦ); ይሕየው ቅድሜየ ‘let him live before me’ (ቅድሜየ ‘before me’). እሬስዮ ‘I will make him’ (1cs of ረሰየ + -ኦ) ሕዝበ ዐቢየ ‘a great people’. ፲ወ፪ is 12, spoken ዐሠርቱ ወክልኤቱ. Genesis 17:20 promises Ishmael twelve princes and a great nation; 21:13, 18 repeat the great nation. Here they become twelve peoples who live under his rule.

sentences.l: And-my-covenant I-establish with Isaac my-servant son-of Sarah, and-I-bless in-his-seed all peoples-of earth, and-I-make-him great kings over all peoples-of earth, and-in-heavens-also I-make-him king.
sentences.i: “But my covenant I will establish with Isaac my servant, the son of Sarah, and in his seed I will bless all the peoples of the earth; and I will make him great kings over all the peoples of the earth, and in the heavens too I will make him king.”
sentences.n: ወኪዳንየሰ ‘and as for my covenant’ (ኪዳን + -የ ‘my’ + -ሰ); ኣቀውም ‘I will establish’ is written with ኣ, a 1cs form of አቀመ (?). Genesis 17:21 has God establish the covenant with Isaac. ወእባርክ በዘርኡ ኵሎሙ አሕዛበ ምድር ‘I will bless in his seed all the peoples of the earth’, the promise of Genesis 22:18 (and 12:3), with አሕዛበ the construct ‘peoples of’. ወእገብሮ ዐበይተ ነገሥተ ‘I will make him great kings’ (?): the object is Isaac, and ‘great kings’ I read as his line of kings (?). በሰማያትኒ ‘in the heavens also’ (plural ሰማያት + -ኒ), where I read Christ’s heavenly kingship, the point towards which the Kebra Nagast’s genealogies run (?). The ፨ ፨ ፨ … row at the end closes the chapter and stays with this unit.

glossary.ተንሥኡ: ተንሥአ — rise! (2mp imperative, Gt) · they arose (3mp perfect)
glossary.ታሕይዊ: አሕየወ — that you let live, keep alive (2fs subjunctive, ʾa-stem causative of ሐይወ, ḥ-y-w)
glossary.ታድኅንያ: አድኀነ — that you save her (2ms subjunctive, ʾa-stem causative of ድኅነ + -ያ '3fs her', anticipating ለነፍስየ)
glossary.ትቀንእ: ቀንአ — she is jealous (3fs imperfect, G, q-n-ʾ)
glossary.ትቤ: ብህለ — she said (3fs perfect ትቤ of the defective verb b-h-l)
glossary.ትቤሎ: ብህለ — you said to him (2ms perfect ትቤ, the same form as 3fs; defective verb b-h-l, + -ሎ '3ms to him') · she said to him (3fs ትቤ + -ሎ '3ms to him', Sarah to Abraham)
glossary.ትገፍዕ: ገፍዐ — you wrong, oppress (2ms imperfect, G, g-f-ʿ)
glossary.ኀበ: ኀበ — to, toward, at; where (preposition / conjunction) · 'with, in the possession of' (ኢተርፈት ኀበ ኢዮርብዓም 'it did not remain with Jeroboam') · opening a title-like clause, 'how' or 'when' (ኀበ አስሐተቶ ለሰሎሞን ወለተ ፈርዖን 'how Pharaoh's daughter led Solomon astray') (?)
glossary.ኀቤሁ: ኀበ — to him (preposition + -hu, ኀቤሁ) · also 'of him' after ሰአለ 'ask' (ሰአለ ኀቤሁ 'he asked of him')
glossary.ኀቤሃ: ኀበ — to her, toward her (preposition ኀበ + -ሃ '3fs') · 'with, beside' (እንተ ኀቤሃ 'who were with her', ch. 55)
glossary.ኀጥአ: ኀጥአ — he lacked (3ms perfect, G, ḫ-ṭ-ʾ; 'lack' taken from context, the usual sense being 'err, sin') (?)
glossary.ኅድግ: ኀደገ — leave! (2ms imperative, G, ḫ-d-g; Bezold's spelling ኅድግ) · forgive! (ኅድግ ሊተ ዛተ አበሳየ 'forgive me this sin of mine')
glossary.ኅድጎ: ኀደገ — leave him! (2ms imperative, G, ḫ-d-g + -ኦ '3ms him')
glossary.ነገሥተ: ንጉሥ — kings (noun, plural ነገሥት, construct 'kings of')
glossary.ነፍስየ: ነፍስ — my soul, my life (noun, fem. + -የ '1cs my')
glossary.ኒዒ: ንዓ — come! (imperative 2fs, written ኒዒ for ንዒ; ms ንዓ, pl ንዑ)
glossary.ናየድዐክሙ: አየድዐ — we shall inform you (1cp imperfect, ʾa-stem causative of y-d-ʿ + -ክሙ '2mp you') (?)
glossary.ናድኅን: አድኀነ — we save (1cp subjunctive, ʾa-stem causative of ድኅነ 'be safe', d-ḫ-n)
glossary.ንሖር: ሖረ — let us go (1cp jussive, G)
glossary.ንብረቶሙ: ንብረት — their way of life, conduct (noun, from ነበረ 'dwell, live' + -ሙ '3mp their')
glossary.ንዋዮ: ንዋይ — his goods, property (noun, accusative + -ሁ '3ms his', ንዋዮ)
glossary.ንጉሠ: ንጉሥ — king (accusative) · also construct 'king of' (ንጉሠ ሮምሂ 'the king of Rome too') · predicate accusative 'as king' (ዘይከውን ንጉሠ 'who will be king'; ይኩነነ ንጉሠ 'may he be king for us')
glossary.ንጹሐ: ንጹሕ — clean, pure, innocent (adjective; accusative form)
glossary.አልቦ: አልቦ — there is not, none (negative existential) · 'no, not so' as a reply (አልቦ እግዚኦ 'No, O lord', ch. 56)
glossary.አሐተ: አሐዱ — one (numeral, fem. accusative; አሐተ ብእሲተ 'one woman')
glossary.አሐዩ: ሐይወ — I live (1cs imperfect, G, ḥ-y-w; spelled አሐዩ, an irregular spelling) (?)
glossary.አሥመርከኒ: አሥመረ — you please me (2ms perfect, ʾa-stem causative of ሠምረ 'be pleased' + -ኒ '1cs me')
glossary.አረፍተ: አረፍት — wall (noun, construct 'wall of'; sense from context) (?)
glossary.አርድእዎ: አርድአ — they informed him (3mp perfect, ʾa-stem, + -ኦ '3ms him', anticipating ለፈርዖን; sense taken from context) (?)
glossary.አኀው: አኅ — brothers (plural of አኅ, አኀው) · siblings, brother and sister together (፪ አኀው 'two siblings')
glossary.አኅለቀ: አኅለቀ — he finished, spent (3ms perfect, ʾa-stem causative of ኀልቀ 'be finished', ḫ-l-q)
glossary.አኅለቁ: አኅለቀ — they are finished, have come to an end (3mp perfect; the ʾa-stem is transitive 'to finish', so this may be a spelling for ኀለቁ) (?)
glossary.አንከሩ: አንከረ — they marvelled, were astonished (3mp perfect, ʾa-stem; with በእንተ 'at')
glossary.አእመርኩ: አእመረ — I knew, I have come to know (1cs perfect, stem አእመረ 'know', root ʿ-m-r)
glossary.አግብርትየ: ገብር — my servants (አግብርት, plural of ገብር 'servant' + -የ 'my')
glossary.አግብእ: አግብአ — give back, bring back (2ms imperative, causative of ገብአ)
glossary.ኢይናፍቅ: ናፈቀ — he does not hesitate, put off (ኢ- + 3ms imperfect; 'delay' taken from context) (?)
glossary.ኣቀውም: አቀመ — I establish (1cs imperfect, ʾa-stem causative of ቆመ; written ኣ) (?)
glossary.ኣአኵቶ: አኰተ — I give thanks to him, praise (1cs imperfect, G + -ኦ '3ms him'; written ኣአኵቶ)
glossary.እሕፅያ: ሐፀወ — that I take her in marriage (1cs subjunctive + -ኣ '3fs her', written -ያ; the verb is spelled with ይ elsewhere, as if ሐፀየ) (?)
glossary.እመ: እመ — if (conjunction) · whether (ጐንደይኩ እመ ትገብእ 'I waited whether she would return') · in case, perhaps (እመ ይሁበከ እግዚኣብሔር ዘርአ 'perhaps God may give you offspring')
glossary.እመውት: ሞተ — I die (1cs imperfect, G, m-w-t)
glossary.እም: እም — mother (noun; ከመ እም 'as a mother')
glossary.እምቃልከ: ቃል — from your word (እም- + noun + -ከ '2ms your')
glossary.እምቅድመ: ቅድመ — before, prior to · 'from before' (እምቅድመ ገጾሙ 'from before their faces')
glossary.እምነ: እም — from, out of (preposition, እምነ before a noun) · 'our mother' (እም 'mother' + -ነ 'our'): ይብልዋ ለጽዮን እምነ 'they will call Zion "our mother"' · 'than' in a comparison (ተፈሥሑ ፈድፋደ እምነ እስራኤል 'rejoiced more than Israel')
glossary.እምነበልባሉ: ነበልባል — from his flame (እም- + noun + -ሁ '3ms his', written -ሉ)
glossary.እምአሐቲ: አሐዱ — from one (እም- + numeral, fem. አሐቲ)
glossary.እምአረፍተ: አረፍት — from the wall of (እም- + noun, construct; 'wall' taken from context) (?)
glossary.እምእዴከ: እድ — from your hand (እም- 'from' + noun + -ከ '2ms your')
glossary.እሞተ: ሞት — from the death of (እም- + ሞት 'death', construct state)
glossary.እሞት: ሞተ — I die (1cs imperfect/subjunctive, G, m-w-t)
glossary.እሬስዮ: ረሰየ — I make him (1cs imperfect, G + -ኦ '3ms him')
glossary.እሴአለ: ሰአለ — I ask (1cs imperfect, G, s-ʾ-l; the printed ending -ለ is unexplained) (?)
glossary.እስከ: እስከ — until, as far as (preposition) · እስከ — conjunction before a verb, 'until' (እስከ የዐዝዞ ማይ 'until the water seizes him')
glossary.እብል: ብህለ — shall I say (1cs imperfect, b-h-l)
glossary.እንተ: እንተ — which, who (rel. pron. fem.) · in the phrase እንተ ባሕቲቱ 'privately, apart' (lit. 'which his solitude'; here the son is drawn aside alone) · fem. relative before a noun, ሐወጸ እንተ ታዕካ ቤተ መንግሥት 'looked out (?), which the ታዕካ of the palace'; the link to the verb is unclear (?) · 'which is' of the place (እንተ ኀበ ቊልፈትክሙ 'which is at your backside (?)') · 'whose' before a possessed noun (እንተ ስማ አቢስ 'whose name is Abishag') · እንተ የብስ 'which [is] dry land': the relative standing after a feminine noun, ባሕር (ትተረጐም, 3fs, shows it is feminine), 'the sea, which [became] dry land'; a prepositional 'by, on' is possible but less likely (?) · fem. relative or link before an adverb of place, 'who/which [was]' (ወሖረት እንተ ድኅሬሁ 'and she went [she] behind him'; ቆብዐ እንተ መትሕተ አክሊሉ 'a cap which [was] beneath his crown') · fem. relative before a verb, 'which' (እንተ ሄደ 'which went (?)')
glossary.እንዘ: እንዘ — while, whilst (conjunction) · 'while', also 'though' in contrast (እንዘ ክቡር ስምነ 'though our name was honored')
glossary.እክል: ክህለ — I can, I am able (1cs imperfect, k-h-l) · grain, produce (noun) in ዐውደ እክል 'threshing floor of grain'
glossary.እድኀን: ድኅነ — I be saved (1cs subjunctive, G, d-ḫ-n)
glossary.እገብር: ገብረ — I do, make (1cs imperfect, G)
glossary.እግበር: ገብረ — that I make (1cs jussive, G, g-b-r)
glossary.እግዚእየ: እግዚእ — my lord (noun + -የ '1cs my') · vocative 'my lord' (ብቊዐኒ እግዚእየ) · in apposition, 'David, my lord' (አቡየ ዳዊት እግዚእየ)
glossary.እፈቅድ: ፈቀደ — I desire, wish (1cs imperfect, G)
glossary.ከላእኩ: ከልአ — I hold back, refuse (1cs perfect, G, k-l-ʾ; perfect in the 'if' clause; 'refuse' taken from context) (?)
glossary.ከመ: ከመ — that, so that; as · 'like' before a noun (ከመ ምድረ በረድ 'like a land of hail') · ከመ ኢ- 'that not, lest' (ከመ ኢትንገሥ ብእሲት 'that a woman not reign'; ከመ ኢታቅሞ 'that you not make him stay') · 'as when' before ዘ- or አመ (ከመ ዘ ዐገትዋ 'as when they besieged her')
glossary.ኪ: ኪ — you (2fs object suffix -ኪ, written apart from the verb እሴአለ)
glossary.ክቡረ: ክቡር — precious, honoured (adjective, accusative, qualifying አልባሰ)
glossary.ክብረ: ክብር — glory, honour (construct 'glory of') · accusative 'glory' (ወሀቦሙ ክብረ 'he gave them glory')
glossary.ኮንኪ: ኮነ — you have become (2fs perfect, G, k-w-n)
glossary.ኮኖ: ኮነ — it was to him, it became for him (3ms perfect, G, + -ኦ '3ms to him')
glossary.ኵሉ: ኵሉ — all, every, the whole of · 'everyone', used alone (ያፈቅር ኵሉ 'everyone loves') · ወበዝ ኵሉ 'and in all this'
glossary.ኵሎሙ: ኵሉ — all of them (+ -omu) · before a noun, 'all' (ኵሎሙ አድያመ ኢትዮጵያ 'all the regions of Ethiopia', ch. 55)
glossary.ወሀበኒ: ወሀበ — he gave me (3ms perfect, G + -ኒ '1cs me')
glossary.ወሀቦ: ወሀበ — he gave him (3ms perfect + -ኦ 3ms object) · with the -ኦ anticipating a ለ- phrase (ወሀቦ ለወልዱ 'he gave him, to his son') · give him! (ወ- + 2ms imperative ሀብ + -ኦ '3ms him', ወሀቦ ወለተከ 'give him your daughter')
glossary.ወለሳራ: ሳራ — and Sarah (ወ- + ለ- marking the object + proper name)
glossary.ወለአከ: ለአከ — and he sent (ወ- + 3ms perfect, G)
glossary.ወለይስማዔልሰ: ይስማዔል — and as for Ishmael (ወ- + ለ- + proper name + emphatic -ሰ)
glossary.ወልደ: ወልድ — son (noun, construct state 'son-of') · accusative 'a son' (ወለደት ወልደ 'she bore a son')
glossary.ወምንተ: ምንት — and what? (ወ- 'and' + interrogative pronoun, accusative)
glossary.ወሦዐ: ሠውዐ — and he sacrificed (ወ- 'and' + 3ms perfect, G, ś-w-ʿ; contracted spelling ሦዐ)
glossary.ወሰመየቶ: ሰመየ — and she named him (ወ- + 3fs perfect + -ኦ '3ms him', joined as ቶ)
glossary.ወሰገዲ: ሰገደ — and they bowed down (ወ- + 3mp perfect, spelled ሰገዲ for ሰገዱ) (?)
glossary.ወሶቤሃ: ሶቤሃ — and then, at that time (ወ- + adverb)
glossary.ወቀርበ: ቀርበ — and he drew near (ወ- + 3ms perfect, G)
glossary.ወበሰማያትኒ: ሰማይ — and in the heavens also (ወ- + በ- + plural ሰማያት + enclitic -ኒ)
glossary.ወበእንተዝ: በእንተዝ — and on this account (ወ- + preposition + demonstrative)
glossary.ወበዝሙት: ዝሙት — and with fornication (ወ- + በ- + noun)
glossary.ወብዕለ: ብዕል — and riches, wealth (ወ- + noun, accusative)
glossary.ወቦአ: ቦአ — and he entered (ወ- + 3ms perfect, G, b-w-ʾ)
glossary.ወቦኡ: ቦአ — and they entered (ወ- + 3mp perfect, G, b-w-ʾ)
glossary.ወተነግፈ: ተነግፈ — and (it) was cut off (ወ- + 3ms perfect, tä-stem passive; 'cut off' taken from context) (?)
glossary.ወተፈሥሐ: ተፈሥሐ — and he rejoiced (ወ- + 3ms perfect, tä-stem)
glossary.ወትቤ: ይቤ — and she said (ወ- + 3fs perfect ትቤ of defective ይቤ)
glossary.ወትቤሎ: ይቤ — and she said to him (ወ- + 3fs ትቤ of defective ይቤ + -ሎ '3ms to him')
glossary.ወትቤሎሙ: ይቤ — and she said to them (ወ- + 3fs perfect ትቤ of the irregular verb 'say' + ሎሙ 'to them')
glossary.ወኀለየ: ኀለየ — and he thought (ወ- + 3ms perfect, G, ḫ-l-y)
glossary.ወኀበ: ኀበ — to, toward, at (preposition; ወ- 'and') · and where, and wherever (conjunction, ወኀበ ሖረ ይተልዎ 'and wherever he went it pursued him')
glossary.ወኀጥአ: ኀጥአ — and he lacked (ወ- + 3ms perfect, G, ḫ-ṭ-ʾ; 'lack' taken from context, the usual sense being 'err, sin') (?)
glossary.ወነሥኣ: ነሥአ — and he took her (ወ- + 3ms perfect, n-ś-ʾ + -ኣ 'her')
glossary.ወአልባሰ: ልብስ — and garments (ወ- + plural አልባስ, accusative)
glossary.ወአልብየ: አልቦ — and there is not to me (ወ- 'and' + negative existential + -የ '1cs to me')
glossary.ወአልቦ: አልቦ — and there is not (ወ- 'and' + negative existential)
glossary.ወአስተርአዮ: አስተርአየ — and (he) appeared to him (ወ- + 3ms perfect, ʾastä-stem of ርእየ + -ኦ '3ms to him')
glossary.ወአብርሀ: አብርሀ — and he/it shone (ወ- + 3ms perfect, causative) · transitive 'and he made shine' (ወአብርሀ ገጾ ላዕሌሆሙ 'and he made his face shine upon them')
glossary.ወአኀዙ: አኀዘ — and they took hold, began (ወ- + 3mp perfect, G)
glossary.ወአንሰ: አነ — and as for me (ወ- 'and' + 1s pronoun + emphatic -ሰ)
glossary.ወአንበራ: አንበረ — and he set her, laid her (ወ- + 3ms perfect, ʾa-stem causative of ነበረ + -ኣ '3fs her')
glossary.ወአእተዋ: አእተወ — and he brought her in (ወ- + 3ms perfect, causative + -ኣ '3fs her') (?)
glossary.ወእማእዝንተ: ማእዝን — and from the corner of (ወ- + እም- + noun, construct ማእዝንተ)
glossary.ወእምድኅሬሁ: ድኅረ — and after him (ወ- 'and' + እም- 'from' + preposition with 3ms suffix -ሁ)
glossary.ወእባርክ: ባረከ — and I bless (ወ- + 1cs imperfect, G, b-r-k)
glossary.ወእገብሮ: ገብረ — and I make him (ወ- + 1cs imperfect, G + -ኦ '3ms him')
glossary.ወኪዳንየሰ: ኪዳን — and as for my covenant (ወ- + noun + -የ '1cs my' + emphatic -ሰ)
glossary.ወወሀበቶ: ወሀበ — and she gave him (ወ- + 3fs perfect + -ኦ '3ms him', joined as ቶ)
glossary.ወወሀቦ: ወሀበ — and he gave him (ወ- + 3ms perfect, w-h-b + -ኦ 'him')
glossary.ወወለደ: ወለደ — and he begot (ወ- + 3ms perfect, w-l-d)
glossary.ወየብሰ: የብስ — and dry land (ወ- + noun, accusative of place 'by land') · accusative object 'and dry land' (ወባሕረ ወየብሰ 'sea and dry land', as things made)
glossary.ወይቤላ: ይቤ — and he said to her (ወ- + 3ms perfect of defective ይቤ + -ላ '3fs to her') · masculine form where a woman speaks to her sister and ትቤላ is expected (ወይቤላ ዝንቱ ንዋየ አቡነ 'and she said to her: this property of our father') (?)
glossary.ወይቤልዋ: ይቤ — and they said to her (ወ- + 3mp perfect of the irregular verb 'say' + -ልዋ 'to her')
glossary.ወይቤልዎ: ብህለ — and they said to him (ወ- 'and' + 3mp perfect ይቤሉ of b-h-l + -ልዎ 'to him')
glossary.ወይቤሎ: ብህለ — and he said to him (ወ- 'and' + 3ms perfect ይቤ of b-h-l + -ሎ 'to him')
glossary.ወይቤሎሙ: ብህለ — and he said to them (ወ- + 3ms perfect ይቤ of b-h-l + -ሎሙ 'to them')
glossary.ወይነሥኣ: ነሥአ — and takes her (ወ- + 3ms subjunctive + -ኣ '3fs her')
glossary.ወይነግሥ: ነግሠ — and he reigns (ወ- + 3ms subjunctive, G, n-g-ś)
glossary.ወይእቲኒ: ይእቲ — and she also (ወ- + 3fs pronoun + enclitic -ኒ)
glossary.ወይወልድ: ወለደ — and he begets (ወ- + 3ms imperfect, G, w-l-d)
glossary.ወይወርስ: ወረሰ — and he inherits (ወ- + 3ms imperfect, G, w-r-s)
glossary.ወገብኡ: ገብአ — and they returned (ወ- + 3mp perfect, G, g-b-ʾ)
glossary.ወግበሪ: ገብረ — and do! (ወ- + 2fs imperative, G, g-b-r)
glossary.ወጐየ: ጐየ — and he fled (ወ- + 3ms perfect, G)
glossary.ወጸንዐ: ጸንዐ — and it grew strong, became severe (ወ- + 3ms perfect, G, ṣ-n-ʿ)
glossary.ወፈቀደ: ፈቀደ — and he wished (ወ- + 3ms perfect, G)
glossary.ወፈነዎ: ፈነወ — and he sent him (ወ- + 3ms perfect, G, f-n-w + -ኦ 'him')
glossary.ወፈንዎ: ፈነወ — and send him! (ወ- + 2ms imperative, G, f-n-w + -ኦ '3ms him')
glossary.ወ፩: ፩ — and one (ወ- + numeral); spoken አሐዱ (ʾäḥädu) 'one'
glossary.ውስተ: ውስተ — in, within, into · to, among (ወለአከ ውስተ ኵሉ ነጋድያን 'and he sent to all the merchants') · at (ውስተ መድረከ ኆኃቲሃ 'at the threshold of her doors') · upon, on (ውስተ ሐቌያቲሆሙ 'upon their hips'; ውስተ መንበረ አቡሁ 'on his father's throne')
glossary.ውእቱ: ውእቱ — he, it (3ms independent pronoun; also serves as copula 'is')
glossary.ውእቱዝ: ውእቱ — this one, he (3ms pronoun + enclitic -ዝ, perhaps demonstrative 'this') (?)
glossary.ዐበይተ: ዐቢይ — great (adjective; plural ዐበይት, accusative form) · as a noun, 'great ones, notables' (construct, ዐበይተ እስራኤል 'notables of Israel')
glossary.ዐባይ: ዐቢይ — great (adjective; spelled ዐባይ, taken as a variant spelling) (?)
glossary.ዓመት: ዓመት — year (noun, fem.; after a numeral)
glossary.ዘርአ: ዘርእ — seed (construct 'seed of') · also 'seed' as sown grain, absolute (ዘርአ ወማእረረ 'seed(time) and harvest') · accusative 'offspring' (ይሁበኒ እግዚኣብሔር ዘርአ 'may God give me offspring') · in apposition to ውሉድ: 'offspring' (አልቦውሉደ ዘርአ 'no child, no seed')
glossary.ዘተወልዲ: ተወልደ — who were born (ዘ- relative + 3mp perfect, tä-stem passive of ወለደ; spelled ተወልዲ, taken for ተወልዱ) (?)
glossary.ዘትቤ: ይቤ — what you said (ዘ- relative + 2ms ትቤ; the prefix forms of defective ይቤ serve as its perfect) · what she said (ዘ- + 3fs ትቤ, the same form: ዘትቤ ሳራ 'what Sarah said')
glossary.ዘትቤለኒ: ብህለ — what you say to me (ዘ- relative + 2ms ትቤ of defective ብህለ + -ለኒ '1cs to me')
glossary.ዘእቤለኪ: ብህለ — what I say to you (ዘ- relative + 1cs imperfect እቤ of defective ብህለ + -ለኪ '2fs to you')
glossary.ዘእትዐደው: ተዐደወ — that I transgress, go beyond (ዘ- 'that which' + 1cs imperfect, tä-stem, ʿ-d-w) (?)
glossary.ዘእንበለ: ዘእንበለ — without, except (preposition) · conjunction 'without' + jussive (ዘእንበለ ይስቅይዋ 'without their watering her') · conjunction + perfect 'without (its having been done)' (ዘእንበለ ተሀበኒ ትእምርተ 'without a sign having been given me') · 'except' (ዘእንበለ ዘተሐምም 'except what she suffered') · conjunction 'before' + subjunctive (ዘእንበለ ይስአሉ አበዊነ ንጉሠ 'before our fathers asked for a king') (?)
glossary.ዘወሀበኒ: ወሀበ — who gave me (ዘ- relative + 3ms perfect + -ኒ '1cs me')
glossary.ዘወሀብከኒ: ወሀበ — which you gave me (ዘ- relative + 2ms perfect, w-h-b + -ኒ '1cs me')
glossary.ዘይመስሎሙ: መሰለ — who resembles them (ዘ- relative + 3ms imperfect, G + -ሎሙ '3mp to them')
glossary.ዘይሴሰይ: ሴሰየ — what one eats (ዘ- 'that which' + 3ms imperfect of the quadriliteral ሴሰየ 'eat, take food')
glossary.ዘይትማሰለኪ: ተማሰለ — who resembles you (ዘ- relative + 3ms imperfect, tä-stem of መሰለ + -ኪ '2fs you')
glossary.ዛተ: ዛቲ — this (fem. demonstrative, accusative ዛተ, qualifying አበሳየ)
glossary.ይሁበከ: ወሀበ — he will give you (3ms imperfect/subjunctive, w-h-b + -ከ '2ms you')
glossary.ይሕየወኒ: ሐይወ — that he live (for me) (3ms subjunctive, G, ḥ-y-w + -ኒ '1cs', dative of interest)
glossary.ይሕየው: ሐይወ — that he live (3ms subjunctive, G, ḥ-y-w)
glossary.ይመስሉ: መሰለ — they resemble, look like (3mp imperfect, G, m-s-l)
glossary.ይመክሩ: መከረ — they plan, plot (3mp imperfect, G, m-k-r)
glossary.ይረስያ: ረሰየ — that he make her (3ms subjunctive, G + -ኣ '3fs her', written -ያ)
glossary.ይቀትለኒ: ቀተለ — he kills me (3ms imperfect + -ኒ '1cs me')
glossary.ይቀትሎ: ቀተለ — he kills him (3ms imperfect + -ኦ '3ms him', anticipating ለወልድየ)
glossary.ይቅትሉኒ: ቀተለ — they kill me (3mp imperfect + -ኒ '1cs me')
glossary.ይቅትሎ: ቀተለ — (that) he kill him (3ms subjunctive + -ኦ '3ms him')
glossary.ይቤለኒ: ብህለ — he said to me (3ms perfect ይቤ of b-h-l + -ለኒ 'to me')
glossary.ይቤላ: ብህለ — he said to her (3ms perfect ይቤ of the defective verb b-h-l, + -ላ '3fs to her')
glossary.ይብል: ብህለ — he says (3ms imperfect, G stem, defective verb b-h-l)
glossary.ይተልዎ: ተለወ — it pursues him (3ms imperfect, G, t-l-w + -ኦ '3ms him'; subject the angel)
glossary.ይትማከሩ: ተማከረ — they take counsel with one another (3mp imperfect, tä-stem reciprocal of መከረ, m-k-r)
glossary.ይትኀባእ: ተኀብአ — he hide (3ms subjunctive, tä-stem, ḫ-b-ʾ)
glossary.ይትወለድ: ተወልደ — he be born (3ms subjunctive, tä-stem passive of ወለደ, after ዘእንበለ)
glossary.ይትገመር: ተገምረ — he be covered, take cover (3ms subjunctive, tä-stem; sense from context, paired with ይትኀባእ) (?)
glossary.ይትገአዙ: ተገአዘ — they urge, press one another (3mp imperfect, tä-stem reciprocal, g-ʾ-z; sense taken from context) (?)
glossary.ይእቱ: ውእቱ — he (3ms pronoun; spelled ይእቱ, perhaps a slip for ውእቱ; before ብሔሮ the sense 'to his own country' is from context) (?)
glossary.ይእቲ: ይእቲ — she/it is (fem. pron.) · 'I am she' predicate (አነ ይእቲ አቡከ 'I am she, your father') · 'that' (fem. demonstrative, ይእቲ ሠሉስ ዕለት 'that third day') · 'she' restating the subject, a resumptive pronoun before a noun (ይእቲ ባሕርይ 'she, the pearl')
glossary.ይኩን: ኮነ — let him be (3m sg jussive, k-w-n) · let it be (3ms jussive, here after ዘእንበለ 'except': ዘእንበለ ይኩን ቆዐ ሠርጸ ጽጌ 'except it be that the tendril put forth blossom') (?)
glossary.ዮጊ: ዮጊ — then (?) (particle; reading uncertain) (?) · perhaps (?) (ትቤ ዮጊ ይቀትሎ ለወልድየ 'she said: perhaps he will kill my son')
glossary.ግብጽ: ግብጽ — Egypt (proper name; genitive after construct) · Egypt as goal of a journey, accusative without a preposition (ርደተ አብርሃም ግብጽ 'descent of Abraham to Egypt') · the Egyptians (ርእይዎሙ ግብጽ 'the Egyptians saw them')
glossary.ጠፋልሐ: ጠፋልሐ — a measure or sum (?) of silver (word unknown to me; sense taken from context, 'he gave him ጠፋልሐ of silver, ፼') (?)
glossary.ጸውዖ: ጸውዐ — he summoned him (3ms perfect, G + -ኦ '3ms him'; also imperative 'call him!')
glossary.፪: ፪ — 2, spoken ክልኤቱ (kəlʾetu) 'two'; chapter number (numeral) · also a counted number 'two' (ዘእንበለ ፪ በትር 'except two rods')
glossary.፹፪: ፹፪ — 82, spoken ሰማንያ ወክልኤቱ (sämanya wä-kəlʾetu) 'eighty-two'; chapter number (numeral)
glossary.፼: ፼ — 10,000, spoken ዐሠርቱ አእላፍ (ʿäśärtu ʾäʾəlaf) 'ten thousand' (?) (numeral, Ethiopic digit ፼; the exact spoken word is uncertain, ትእልፊት being another word for a myriad (?))
